_comment: ADR Guardian SessionStart hook entry for .claude/settings.json
_note: Add this entry under hooks.SessionStart[0].hooks[] in the project's .claude/settings.json.
command: _PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || command -v py) && [ -n "$_PY" ] && ADR_KIT=$(ls -d ~/.claude/plugins/cache/rvdbreemen-adr-kit/adr-kit/*/ 2>/dev/null | "$_PY" -c 'import re, sys; d = [l.strip() for l in sys.stdin if l.strip()]; k = lambda p: [int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", p.rstrip("/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1])]; sys.stdout.write(max(d, key=k) if d else "")' 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$ADR_KIT" ] && "$_PY" "$ADR_KIT/bin/adr-guardian" check 2>/dev/null || true
